offering_description.value: Veralto provides water management, treatment and purification technology for municipal and wastewater facilities and organizations that manage natural waters. Its operating companies also help businesses in food, pharmaceutical and essential goods supply chains trace and authenticate products.

quotes.quote: Our Water Quality companies help our customers manage, treat, purify, and protect the world’s waters, from municipal and wastewater treatment facilities to lakes, rivers, watersheds, and oceans.

Our Product Quality and Innovation companies help our customers protect food, medicine, and essential goods by enabling the traceability and authentication of billions of products that travel the global supply chain every day.

primary_products.value: Water monitoring instruments and software; product traceability and authentication technology

quotes.quote: Ott provides water professionals with trusted, connected intelligence to manage environmental and process water systems with confidence. Its integrated instrumentation and software deliver scalable, network-ready data—from single sites to global operations—while maintaining compatibility and consistency. Designed for simplicity and clarity, Ott’s solutions help users at every level focus on meaningful decisions from complex data.
